messages.subject: getPerson() after GUI doesn't work | mirtCAT

The getPerson() function in mirtCAT renders the error: "person[[i]] : subscript out of bounds" and it seems unrelated to how the mirtCAT_preamble() has set up, even with the simplest demo.  

Would you show me where I may go wrong?

Best,
Allen

messages.subject: Re: getPerson() after GUI doesn't work | mirtCAT
parts:
Of course. I attached my working example down below. I also tried the demo in the Package manual.

Thanks for your help,
Allen

_______________


```{r}
nGAD <- 7
itemNo <- paste0('Item.', 1:nGAD)
a1 <- c(2.64, 3.55, 3.10, 2.74, 1.69, 1.69, 2.32)
d1 <- c(4.27, 6.37, 5.07, 4.25, 4.30, 4.06, 4.86)
d2 <- c(2.83, 4.24, 3.20, 2.30, 2.94, 2.44, 3.53)
d3 <- c(-0.46, 0.74, -0.20, -0.78, 1.04, -0.36, 0.93)
pars_mod1 <- as.data.frame(cbind(a1,d1,d2,d3))
mod1 <- generate.mirt_object(pars_mod1, 'graded') 
coef(mod1)
```

```{r}
question <- answers <- character(nGAD)
choices <- matrix(NA, nGAD, 3)
question[1] <- "Feeling nervous anxiety"
question[2] <- "Not able to stop worrying"
question[3] <- "Worrying too much"
question[4] <- "Trouble relaxing"
question[5] <- "Hard to sit still"
question[6] <- "Becoming easily annoyed"
question[7] <- "Something might happen"
GAD_grades <- c("Not at all", "Several days", "More than half the days")

for(i in 1:nGAD){
  choices[i, ] <- GAD_grades
}

df <- data.frame(Question=question, Option=choices,Type = 'radio', stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
head(df)
```

```{r}
mirtCAT_preamble(df, mod1)
runApp(createShinyGUI(host_server = FALSE), port = 8000)
a <- getPerson()
```

Can you provide a reproducible example of this? Thanks.

Phil

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: getPerson() after GUI doesn't work | mirtCAT
parts:
The previously reported bug was because there was a Type = 'none' argument specified in the df object and the results were run in offline mode. Does your problem have a similar setup? In any case, I'd recommend installing the dev version first to see if this problem persists.

Phil
